title: Global existence analysis for a class of compressible Navier-Stokes-Korteweg equations
summary: The existence of global weak solutions to a broad class of Navier-Stokes-Korteweg equations is established for large data in the three-dimensional torus, including the diffuse-interface and quantum Navier-Stokes systems as special cases. The model consists of the compressible Navier-Stokes equations with degenerate density-dependent viscosity and a general nonlinear third-order Korteweg term.
